answer.description: Process an agent's answer to a training question and queue the next training message. Either answer text or ack_read flag must be provided.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent submitting the answer

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

answer.description: The answer text to the training question (alternative to ack_read)

ack_read.description: Acknowledge that the document was read without providing an answer (alternative to answer)

promote.description: Promote an agent to a new role and queue role-specific training. Agent must be inactive (will be punched out if active).

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to promote

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

role.description: The new role to promote the agent to

onboard.description: Create a new training agent and begin onboarding process. Automatically creates agent with 'apprentice' role and queues first training message.

unsubscribe_operator.description: Unsubscribe an agent from receiving messages from an operator. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to remove the subscription for

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

operator_id.description: The ID of the operator to unsubscribe from

unsubscribe_docket.description: Unsubscribe an agent from receiving messages related to a specific work docket. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to remove the subscription for

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

docket_id.description: The ID of the work docket to unsubscribe from

unsubscribe_keyword.description: Unsubscribe an agent from receiving messages related to a specific keyword. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to remove the subscription for

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

keyword_id.description: The ID of the keyword to unsubscribe from

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to remove the subscription for

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

sidecar_file_id.description: The ID of the sidecar file to unsubscribe from

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to remove the subscription for

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

step_id.description: The ID of the step to unsubscribe from

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to remove the subscription for

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

task_id.description: The ID of the task to unsubscribe from

unsubscribe_ask.description: Unsubscribe an agent from receiving messages related to a specific ask. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to remove the subscription for

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

ask_id.description: The ID of the ask to unsubscribe from

unsubscribe_agent.description: Unsubscribe an agent from receiving messages from another agent. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to remove the subscription for

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

target_agent_id.description: The ID of the target agent to unsubscribe from

subscribe_operator.description: Subscribe an agent to receive messages from an operator. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to create the subscription for

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

operator_id.description: The ID of the operator to subscribe to

all_back_data.description: Include all historical data in the subscription (optional)

new_only.description: Only include new data going forward (optional)

subscribe_docket.description: Subscribe an agent to receive messages related to a specific work docket. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to create the subscription for

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

docket_id.description: The ID of the work docket to subscribe to

all_back_data.description: Include all historical data in the subscription (optional)

new_only.description: Only include new data going forward (optional)

keyword_id.description: The ID of the keyword to subscribe to

all_back_data.description: Include all historical data in the subscription (optional)

new_only.description: Only include new data going forward (optional)

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to create the subscription for

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

sidecar_file_id.description: The ID of the sidecar file to subscribe to

all_back_data.description: Include all historical data in the subscription (optional)

new_only.description: Only include new data going forward (optional)

subscribe_step.description: Subscribe an agent to receive messages related to a specific step. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to create the subscription for

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

step_id.description: The ID of the step to subscribe to

all_back_data.description: Include all historical data in the subscription (optional)

new_only.description: Only include new data going forward (optional)

subscribe_task.description: Subscribe an agent to receive messages related to a specific task. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to create the subscription for

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

task_id.description: The ID of the task to subscribe to

all_back_data.description: Include all historical data in the subscription (optional)

new_only.description: Only include new data going forward (optional)

subscribe_ask.description: Subscribe an agent to receive messages related to a specific ask. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to create the subscription for

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

ask_id.description: The ID of the ask to subscribe to

all_back_data.description: Include all historical data in the subscription (optional)

new_only.description: Only include new data going forward (optional)

subscribe_agent.description: Subscribe an agent to receive messages from another agent. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to create the subscription for

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

target_agent_id.description: The ID of the target agent to subscribe to

all_back_data.description: Include all historical data in the subscription (optional)

new_only.description: Only include new data going forward (optional)

sip.description: Consume and remove queued messages for an agent. Messages are removed from queues after being retrieved.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent whose messages to consume

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation (optional)

channels.description: Comma-separated list of channels to consume (defaults to all channels if not provided). Valid channels: docket, ask, task, step, sidecar, keyword, agent, operator, dm

gulp.description: Export queued messages for an agent to a file. Messages are removed from queues after export.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent whose messages to export

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation (optional)

channels.description: Comma-separated list of channels to export (defaults to all channels if not provided). Valid channels: docket, ask, task, step, sidecar, keyword, agent, operator, dm

output_file.description: Optional output file path. If not provided, a default filename is generated based on agent name.

gossip.description: Send a message from one agent to another. Creates a watercooler message and queues it for the target agent.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent sending the message

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation (optional)

to_agent_id.description: The ID of the target agent (alternative to to_full_name)

to_full_name.description: The full name of the target agent (alternative to to_agent_id)

meta_json.description: Optional JSON metadata to attach to the message

punch_out.description: Punch out an agent to end a work session. Sets agent status to inactive.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to punch out

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

punch_in.description: Punch in an agent to start a work session. Creates or updates agent profile and sets status to active.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to punch in

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

agent_purge.description: Archive active agents (excluding operators) and clean up related data. Requires confirmation flag for safety. Use dry-run to preview changes.

confirm.description: Confirmation flag required for purge operation. Must be set to true to proceed.

dry_run.description: Preview what would be affected without making changes

status.description: Get comprehensive status for an agent including training progress, answers, and current state.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to get status for

badge_ts.description: The badge timestamp for agent identity validation

peek.description: View queued messages without removing them from queues. Can filter by agent and channels.

agent_id.description: Optional agent ID to filter messages. If not provided, shows messages for all agents.

channels.description: Comma-separated list of channels to view (defaults to all channels if not provided). Valid channels: docket, ask, task, step, sidecar, keyword, agent, operator, dm

deep.description: Enable deep mode for additional message details

agent_tree.description: Get detailed information about a specific agent including basic profile data, work docket assignment, and optional deep mode for comprehensive activity logs, subscriptions, linked items, and runtime state.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to retrieve information for

deep.description: Enable deep mode for comprehensive additional data including activity logs, subscriptions, and relationship data

agent_list.description: List available agents with optional filtering by role, status, ask/task/step, and other criteria.

status.description: Filter agents by status (defaults to 'active' if not provided)

ask_id.description: Filter agents that have activity related to a specific ask

task_id.description: Filter agents that have activity related to a specific task

step_id.description: Filter agents that have activity related to a specific step

deep.description: Enable deep mode for additional details

limit.description: Limit the number of results returned

modify_caption.description: Modify the caption of an image. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

image_id.description: The ID of the image to modify

id.description: Alternative parameter name for image_id (use either image_id or id)

caption.description: The new caption text for the image

clear.description: If true, clears the caption (sets to empty string). Use this instead of providing an empty caption string.

upload_images.description: Upload one or more images to a page from temp files. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions. Pass files using the _files parameter (e.g., _files=["path/to/file1.jpg", "path/to/file2.jpg"]). The system automatically handles file upload via multipart/form-data. Processes files sequentially and stops on any error.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to upload the image(s) to

caption.description: Optional caption for all images (defaults to original filename for each image)

_files.description: Array of file paths to upload. The system handles the file upload automatically.

show_image.description: Show image details by ID. Returns complete image data including usage, instances, and metadata.

id.description: The ID of the image to show

json.description: If true, returns JSON format output (optional)

modify_mcp_action_request.description: Modify an MCP action request. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

page_id.description: The ID of the MCP action request page to modify

id.description: Alternative parameter name for page_id (use either page_id or id)

tool_name.description: The tool name for the MCP action request

extraction_spec.description: JSON string for the extraction spec

status.description: Status of the MCP action request

is_create.description: Whether this is a create operation

is_read.description: Whether this is a read operation

is_update.description: Whether this is an update operation

is_delete.description: Whether this is a delete operation

modify_mcp_request.description: Modify an MCP request. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

page_id.description: The ID of the MCP request page to modify

id.description: Alternative parameter name for page_id (use either page_id or id)

input_request.description: JSON string for the input request

output_response.description: JSON string for the output response

set_image_rank.description: Change the rank/position of an image within a page. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

page_id.description: The ID of the page containing the image

image_id.description: The ID of the image to reorder

target_rank.description: The new rank position for the image

source_rank.description: Optional current rank of the image (auto-detected if not specified and only one instance exists)

remove_image.description: Remove an image from a page. Can remove a specific instance by rank or all instances. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

page_id.description: The ID of the page containing the image

image_id.description: The ID of the image to remove

rank.description: Optional rank of the specific image instance to remove (if not specified, removes all instances)

move_images.description: Move multiple images from a source page to a target page. Can move all images or specific ones by rank. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

source_page.description: The ID of the source page containing the images

target_page.description: The ID of the target page to move images to

source_rank.description: Optional comma-separated list of ranks to move (if not specified, moves all images)

target_rank.description: Optional starting rank position for moved images in the target page

move_image.description: Move a single image from a source page to a target page. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

source_page.description: The ID of the source page containing the image

image_id.description: The ID of the image to move

target_page.description: The ID of the target page to move the image to

source_rank.description: Optional rank of the image in the source page (auto-detected if not specified and only one instance exists)

target_rank.description: Optional rank position for the image in the target page

copy_images.description: Copy multiple images to a target page. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

target_page.description: The ID of the target page to copy images to

image_id.description: Comma-separated list of image IDs to copy

rank.description: Optional starting rank position for the copied images

copy_image.description: Copy a single image to a target page. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

target_page.description: The ID of the target page to copy the image to

image_id.description: The ID of the image to copy

rank.description: Optional rank position for the copied image

copy_page.description: Copy a page (and optionally its children recursively) to a target parent page. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

source_page.description: The ID of the page to copy

target_page.description: The ID of the target parent page where the copy will be created

recursive.description: Whether to recursively copy all child pages (default: false)

move_page.description: Move a page to a different parent page. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

source_page.description: The ID of the page to move

target_page.description: The ID of the new parent page

delete_page.description: Delete a page and all its children. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions. The confirm parameter must be set to true to proceed with deletion.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to delete

confirm.description: Confirmation flag required for page deletion. Must be set to true to proceed.

add_page.description: Create a new page under a target parent page. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

target_page.description: The ID of the parent page under which to create the new page

name.description: The name for the new page. Required for page classes that don't allow null names.

class.description: The page class type (defaults to 'page' if not specified)

modify_text.description: Modify the text content of a page. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to modify

id.description: Alternative parameter name for page_id (use either page_id or id)

text.description: The new text content for the page

modify_name.description: Modify the name of a page. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to modify

id.description: Alternative parameter name for page_id (use either page_id or id)

name.description: The new name for the page. Can be empty string or null if the page class allows null names.

help.description: Get help documentation for a topic and optional section. Returns help content in JSON format.

topic.description: The help topic to retrieve (defaults to 'help' if not provided)

section.description: Optional specific section within the topic

get_add_page_class_info.description: Get allowed child page classes for a parent page. Returns list of page classes that can be created as children, including whether they allow null names, duplicate names, and auto-link names.

page_id.description: The ID of the parent page

id.description: Alternative parameter name for page_id (use either page_id or id)

get_text.description: Get processed/parsed text for a page. Returns HTTP-rendered text processed through TextProcessor with final_decorator='http'.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to get processed text for

id.description: Alternative parameter name for page_id (use either page_id or id)

count_pages.description: Count the total number of pages and images in the database.

show_page.description: Show page with full details by ID, name, or link. Returns complete page data including hierarchy and content.

id.description: The ID of the page to show

name.description: The name/link of the page to show (alternative to id)

link.description: The link of the page to show (alternative to id or name)

get_page.description: Get page data by ID, name, or link. Returns JSON-friendly page data including children, images, and metadata.

id.description: The ID of the page to retrieve

name.description: The name/link of the page to retrieve (alternative to id)

link.description: The link of the page to retrieve (alternative to id or name)

modify_language.description: Modify the programming language of a source code file page. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

page_id.description: The ID of the source code file page to modify

id.description: Alternative parameter name for page_id (use either page_id or id)

language.description: The new programming language for the source code file (e.g., 'python', 'javascript', 'markdown')

modify_path.description: Modify the file path of a source code file page. Requires admin/panel tier access with database write permissions.

page_id.description: The ID of the source code file page to modify

id.description: Alternative parameter name for page_id (use either page_id or id)

path.description: The new file path for the source code file

modify_work_sort_order.description: Modify the sort_order of a work page (work docket, ask, task, or step).

page_id.description: The ID of the work page

sort_order.description: The new sort_order for the work page

modify_work_meta_set_all.description: Replace the entire meta JSON field of a work page with a new JSON object. Use empty JSON {} to clear all meta.

page_id.description: The ID of the work page

meta.description: The complete meta JSON object as a string (use {} to clear all meta)

modify_work_meta_remove_pair.description: Remove a single key from the meta JSON field of a work page.

page_id.description: The ID of the work page

key.description: The key to remove from the meta JSON object

modify_work_meta_set_pair.description: Set/add/update a single key-value pair in the meta JSON field of a work page.

page_id.description: The ID of the work page

key.description: The key to set in the meta JSON object

value.description: The value to set for the key (can be a JSON string for nested objects/arrays)

modify_work_status.description: Modify the status of a work page (work docket, ask, task, or step).

page_id.description: The ID of the work page

status.description: The new status for the work page
